summary: The V5 run achieves 27/31 (87%) PASS with one concrete output defect (1 missing 依赖关系 section in backends/DETAIL.md) and one systemic documentation pattern issue (agents group multiple source files under single <!-- file: --> markers, causing 5 modules to fall below 80% per-module file coverage by strict marker count). The core Skill pipeline is sound: analysis, DETAIL generation with function-level dependency enrichment, and INDEX assembly all work correctly. The biggest gap is a Skill documentation ambiguity: phase3-detail.md never explicitly prohibits grouped file documentation, allowing agents to legitimately group 10-30 files under a handful of markers — which passes overall 81.37% coverage but fails the per-module 80% criterion for 5 modules. The single missing section in backends is an Agent validation failure (Step 4 post-write check was not thorough enough). Priority fix: (1) patch backends/DETAIL.md to add the missing 依赖关系 section, and (2) add explicit 'one marker per file' rule to phase3-detail.md to prevent the grouping pattern.
